name: Super ii Robot
description: An evidence-backed, agent-readable catalogue for making Raspberry Pi and NVIDIA Jetson robots.
rankingPolicy: Compatibility results are ordered by requirement fit and evidence completeness. Payment, sponsorship, and commercial relationships never improve compatibility rank.

evidenceStates.label: Verified
evidenceStates.meaning: Super ii holds direct test evidence for this exact claim and revision.

evidenceStates.label: Declared
evidenceStates.meaning: The named manufacturer or official documentation makes this claim. Super ii has not independently tested it.

evidenceStates.label: Derived
evidenceStates.meaning: The claim follows from matching documented constraints, but has not been directly tested.

evidenceStates.label: Unknown
evidenceStates.meaning: The available evidence is not sufficient to make this claim.

components.name: Raspberry Pi 5
components.summary: A documented Linux single-board computer with GPIO, USB, MIPI camera/display connections, PCIe and a large maker ecosystem.

specifications.label: Memory variants
specifications.value: 1 GB, 2 GB, 4 GB, 8 GB and 16 GB LPDDR4X

specifications.label: Expansion
specifications.value: 40-pin GPIO header and PCIe 2.0 x1 through a separate adapter

specifications.label: Power input
specifications.value: 5 V / 5 A USB-C Power Delivery recommended for full peripheral budget

sources.title: Raspberry Pi 5 product page and specification

unknowns: A particular robot's sustained workload and enclosure determine whether additional cooling is sufficient.
GPIO voltage, current and protective circuitry must be checked for each attached controller.

components.name: Camera Module 3
components.summary: An official 12-megapixel autofocus camera offered in visible-light, NoIR, standard-field and wide-field variants.

specifications.label: Variants
specifications.value: Standard or wide field of view; visible-light or NoIR

specifications.label: Board connector
specifications.value: 15-pin camera connector; Raspberry Pi 5 needs the appropriate standard-to-mini cable

unknowns: Mechanical mounting and field of view depend on the selected rover enclosure and camera variant.
A compatible cable is not proof that a specific enclosure has sufficient clearance.

components.name: Active Cooler for Raspberry Pi 5
components.summary: An official cooling option for Raspberry Pi 5 under sustained load when the board is used without the official fan case.

specifications.label: Use case
specifications.value: Sustained or demanding workloads without the official fan case

unknowns: Enclosure clearance and airflow must still be checked in the completed Robot.

components.name: 27 W USB-C Power Supply
components.summary: The official 5 V / 5 A USB-C supply recommended to give Raspberry Pi 5 its full peripheral power budget while connected to mains power.
unknowns: This is not a mobile battery and does not power the rover away from mains electricity.

components.name: Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit
components.summary: A compact Jetson developer kit for prototyping edge AI and robotics applications with NVIDIA's JetPack software stack.

specifications.label: Purpose
specifications.value: Development and prototyping, not a production deployment module

specifications.label: Expansion
specifications.value: Reference carrier board with standard development interfaces

sources.title: Jetson developer kit and module distinction

unknowns: The required JetPack release depends on the exact application, carrier board and peripheral drivers.
A production Robot should be re-qualified against a production Jetson module and carrier board.

components.name: WAVE ROVER
components.summary: A four-wheel mobile base whose manufacturer declares host support for Raspberry Pi and Jetson Orin Nano through its ESP32-based controller.

specifications.label: Drive
specifications.value: Four-wheel drive with four geared motors

specifications.label: Host communication
specifications.value: UART through the onboard ESP32-based controller

specifications.label: Power architecture
specifications.value: Onboard 3S UPS module; cells are not included

specifications.label: Declared hosts
specifications.value: Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano and Jetson Orin Nano families

unknowns: Super ii has not independently tested the Raspberry Pi 5 or Jetson Orin Nano integration.
Battery cells, charger suitability and safe installation require separate review.
Payload, runtime, waterproofing and obstacle-navigation performance are not established by this profile.

compatibility.claim: Raspberry Pi documents Camera Module 3 support on Raspberry Pi computers with CSI connectors; Raspberry Pi 5 needs the appropriate 22-pin-to-15-pin camera cable.
conditions: Use the correct Raspberry Pi 5 camera cable
Check mechanical clearance before installing cooling hardware

compatibility.claim: The Active Cooler is an official Raspberry Pi 5 accessory for sustained workloads.
conditions: Confirm clearance with camera cables, HATs and the selected robot mount

compatibility.claim: Raspberry Pi recommends a 5 V / 5 A USB-C supply for Raspberry Pi 5's full peripheral power budget.
conditions: Do not treat this adapter as a mobile battery system

compatibility.claim: Waveshare declares Raspberry Pi host support for WAVE ROVER through the base controller's serial interface.
conditions: Confirm the exact host mount, cabling, software revision and power arrangement
Super ii has not independently tested this pairing

compatibility.claim: Waveshare declares Jetson Orin Nano host support for WAVE ROVER through the base controller's serial interface.
conditions: Confirm the exact carrier-board mount, cabling, software revision and power arrangement
Super ii has not independently tested this pairing

referenceRobots.title: Rover One
referenceRobots.summary: A deliberately bounded indoor vision-rover starting point that shows what changes when its compute moves from Raspberry Pi 5 to Jetson Orin Nano.
referenceRobots.environment: Indoor development area with direct human supervision

variants.name: Raspberry Pi path
variants.why: The clearest learning path, broad documentation and a lower-complexity Linux environment.
openRequirements: Choose and validate the exact camera mount and cable routing.
Use only manufacturer-supported cells and charging practices for the mobile base.
Define a physical emergency-stop or immediate power-removal method before powered movement.
Measure actual runtime and thermal behavior; do not infer them from nominal specifications.

variants.name: Jetson path
variants.why: More headroom for local perception and accelerated AI, with additional power, thermal and software-version responsibilities.
openRequirements: Select a camera with explicit support for the exact Jetson carrier board and JetPack release.
Qualify host power separately from the rover motor power system.
Confirm physical mounting, airflow and cable strain relief.
Define a physical emergency-stop or immediate power-removal method before powered movement.
Move to a production module and carrier-board review before treating the design as a product.

stages.label: Describe
stages.copy: State the goal, environment, budget, experience and hardware already owned.

stages.label: Design
stages.copy: Choose a source-backed compute path and identify every remaining component role.

stages.label: Robot Check
stages.copy: Separate electrical, interface, software, mechanical and safety evidence.

stages.label: Make
stages.copy: Follow bounded assembly and software stages while preserving manufacturer instructions.

stages.label: Test
stages.copy: Record observed results; an untested claim remains declared, derived or unknown.

stages.label: Share
stages.copy: Publish only the Robot version and evidence intended for public use.

referenceRobots.safety: Rover One is a planning and learning reference, not a safety certification or authorization to operate hardware. Keep powered movement supervised, use manufacturer instructions, and obtain qualified review for batteries, high current, hazardous tools, public spaces, payloads or production use.

free: Public Robot MCP, A2A and API
team: Existing organization roles and audit boundaries
manufacturer: Commercial organization workflow for proposing evidence-backed profile maintenance
Agent-discovery analytics only when real activity exists
